mapper.insert: insert into telers.clazz(name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, subject, create_time, update_time) values (#{name},#{room},#{beginDate},#{endDate},#{masterId},#{subject},#{createTime},#{updateTime})
mapper.update: update telers.clazz set name=#{name}, room=#{room}, begin_date=#{beginDate}, end_date=#{endDate}, master_id=#{masterId}, subject=#{subject}, update_time=#{updateTime} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.*,e.name master_name from telers.clazz c left join telers.emp e on c.master_id=e.id where c.id=#{id}
